title: Practice 8: Perfective or imperfective? The prefixed verbs in use

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Tom took Mary to Acapulco.
exercises.why: **свозил** — past tense (masculine) of свозить: imperfective (perfective partner: свезти).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: I spent a week in the hospital.
exercises.why: **провёл** — past tense (masculine) of провести: perfective (imperfective partner: проводить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: They came in full force.
exercises.why: **пришли** — past tense (plural) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: He spent half his life in prison.
exercises.why: **провёл** — past tense (masculine) of провести: perfective (imperfective partner: проводить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: Have you ever got across a river by swimming?
exercises.why: **переплывал** — past tense (masculine) of переплывать: imperfective (perfective partner: переплыть).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: Tom leveled a shotgun at me.
exercises.why: **навёл** — past tense (masculine) of навести: perfective (imperfective partner: наводить).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: The economy has entered a recession.
exercises.why: **вошла** — past tense (feminine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: He dropped in to see us.
exercises.why: **зашёл** — past tense (masculine) of зайти: perfective (imperfective partner: заходить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: The story drew to a conclusion.
exercises.why: **подошла** — past tense (feminine) of подойти: perfective (imperfective partner: подходить).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

exercises.q: I crawled out of bed and got dressed.
exercises.why: **выполз** — past tense (masculine) of выползти: perfective (imperfective partner: выползать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Japanese forces marched into Burma.
exercises.why: **вошли** — past tense (plural) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: The plane flew over Mt. Fuji.
exercises.why: **пролетел** — past tense (masculine) of пролететь: perfective (imperfective partner: пролетать).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: She spent seven years in Siberia.
exercises.why: **провела** — past tense (feminine) of провести: perfective (imperfective partner: проводить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: I spent my childhood in Pakistan.
exercises.why: **провёл** — past tense (masculine) of провести: perfective (imperfective partner: проводить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: I brought sausages from Germany.
exercises.why: **привез** — past tense (masculine) of привезти: perfective (imperfective partner: привозить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: She tiptoed into the house.
exercises.why: **вошла** — past tense (feminine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: I saw Tom swimming across the river.
exercises.why: **переплывал** — past tense (masculine) of переплывать: imperfective (perfective partner: переплыть).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: Tom let the garden go to rack and ruin.
exercises.why: **довёл** — past tense (masculine) of довести: perfective (imperfective partner: доводить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: The birds flew away in all directions.
exercises.why: **разлетелись** — past tense (plural) of разлететься: perfective (imperfective partner: разлетаться).  Prefix **раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся)**: divergent movement in various directions from one center (по + dat. pl.; в + acc. pl).

exercises.q: Tom took his children to a pet store.
exercises.why: **сводил** — past tense (masculine) of сводить: imperfective (perfective partner: свести).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).
